title: SPI Controller Transfer
text: Write data to and read data from SPI peripheral device, 1 input, 1 output, {Register address} sets SPI register address; {SPI module}, {Clock polarity} sets the sPI clock polarity, {Clock phase} sets the sPI clock phase, {Enable register address} sets the enables SPI register address, {Data bits} sets the number of bits in SPI transfer, {Chip select calling method} sets the method to select SPI peripheral device Provided by the SPI, {Chip select pin polarity} sets the sPI peripheral select pin polarity Active and {Chip select pin} sets the sPI peripheral select pin. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Tx
ports.summary: Data written to registers of SPI peripheral device (MOSI) vector

ports.name: Rx
ports.summary: Data read from registers of SPI peripheral device (MISO) vector

params.name: SPI module
params.values: SPI module to write and read data SPI_A (default) | SPI_B | SPI_C | SPI_D

params.name: Enable register address
params.values: Enables SPI register address on (default) | off

params.name: Register address
params.values: SPI register address 0 (default) | positive integer scalar | positive integer vector

params.name: Data bits
params.values: Number of bits in SPI transfer 8 (default) | integer in the range [1 16]

params.name: Chip select calling method
params.values: Method to select SPI peripheral device Provided by the SPI peripheral (default) | Explicit GPIO calls

params.name: Chip select pin polarity
params.values: SPI peripheral select pin polarity Active low (default) | Active high

params.name: Chip select pin
params.values: SPI peripheral select pin 1 (default) | positive integer scalar
